textos.Reviews afirmam que as piadas não funcio: Reviews state that the jokes do not work today, sound repetitive and childish, and that the slapstick comedy does not provoke laughter, being compared to television sketches or outdated humor.
textos.O filme é descrito como lento, monótono: The film is described as slow, monotonous and boring, with scenes that run too long and a runtime that feels longer than it really is, leading viewers to lose focus or want to sleep.
textos.As reviews apontam que as mesmas piadas: Reviews note that the same jokes and situations repeat to exhaustion, without variation, making the film predictable and tiring.
textos.Espectadores consideram a mensagem antic: Viewers consider the anti-capitalist message and the critique of industrialization to be handled in a shallow, childish or secondary way, without the development the theme would demand.
textos.Espectadores relatam não se adaptar a fi: Viewers report not adapting to silent, black-and-white films, finding the absence of dialogue an obstacle to connecting with the story and the characters.

textos.Reviews criticam o próprio Chaplin, cons: Reviews criticize Chaplin himself, considering his character irritating or incompetent, and reviews mention discomfort with the actor's personal matters, such as the age difference in the relationships portrayed.
textos.A obra retrata a desumanização do trabal: The work portrays the dehumanization of industrial labor, the mechanization of life and social inequalities, remaining relevant nearly a century later.
textos.Comédia pastelão e atuação física de Cha: Slapstick comedy and Chaplin's physical performance
textos.O humor físico e as acrobacias de Chapli: Chaplin's physical humor and acrobatics are highlighted as impressive and funny, though viewers find the jokes repetitive.

textos.Reviews consideram a história arrastada: Reviews consider the story drawn-out or repetitive, with episodes that run too long, while others find the pacing appropriate.
textos.Espectadores do grupo sentem que o filme: Viewers in this group feel that the film shows its age and is not as gripping as modern productions, even while acknowledging its historical importance.

textos.As reviews destacam a crítica à exploraç: Reviews highlight the critique of the exploitation of the working class and of the dehumanization caused by capitalism, noting how the film portrays the transformation of the human being into a cog in the productive machine.
textos.Este grupo elogia a atuação e a direção: This group praises Chaplin's acting and direction, regarded as a genius of comedy and silent cinema, with flawless physical performances and timing.
textos.As reviews positivas apontam que o humor: Positive reviews note that the timeless humor and the physical gags are still funny even after decades, with comic situations that work very well.

textos.Reviews positivas relatam ser a primeira: Positive reviews report it as their first experience with a Chaplin film, noting how the work exceeded expectations and sparked interest in watching more of his films.
